column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying the clinician (e.g., 'CLN001').
An enum (clinicianconfidence_enum) capturing the clinician's confidence (Medium, Low, High).
An enum (assessmentlimitations_enum) describing any limitations (Cognitive, Engagement, Language).
An enum (documentationstatus_enum) for documentation status (Complete, Incomplete, Pending).
A VARCHAR(15) storing billing or service code (e.g., '99214').
A DATE indicating next planned review date (e.g., '2025-06-01').
An enum (carecoordination_enum) describing care coordination level (Intensive, Regular, Limited).
An enum (referralneeds_enum) capturing referral needs (Services, Testing, Specialist).
An enum (followuptype_enum) describing follow-up type (Therapy, Routine, Urgent, Medication Check).
An enum (followupfrequency_enum) describing follow-up frequency (Weekly, Quarterly, Biweekly, Monthly).
A VARCHAR(20) FK referencing Facilities(FacKey), linking this clinician to a facility.
